entities.summary: Wycliffe K. Grousbeck is an American entrepreneur. He was lead owner and Governor of the Boston Celtics of the National Basketball Association from December 2002 until August 2025, winning two NBA Finals during that time. Grousbeck now serves as co-lead owner and CEO of the team alongside William Chisholm.
